egin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch5:5-2↗ prob:connection-1forms-cartan

Let $ abla $ be a connection on the tangent bundle of a Riemannian manifold $(M,g)$. Show that $ abla $ is compatible with $g$ if and only if the connection 1-forms $\omega _i^j$ (Problem 4-14) with respect to each local frame $(E_i)$ satisfy \[ g_{jk}\omega _i^k + g_{ik}\omega _j^k = dg_{ij}. \] Show that this implies that with respect to every local orthonormal frame, the matrix $(\omega _i^j)$ is skew-symmetric. \end{exercise}
